decisions.reason: The added CMYK and Pantone reference documentation is already owned by the color-specification Requirement; the requirement to deliver production-ready artwork remains valid unchanged.
Color-reference documentation does not alter the confirmed seam allowance, measurements, or rolled-hem requirement.
Providing CMYK values and Pantone equivalents does not change the Terracotta pareo's selected color, border color, or border-scale options.
The documentation decision does not change the Basket Weave design, selected palette direction, repeat structure, or border treatment.
Providing final color-reference documentation does not change the Mustard pareo's interior color, border color, or border-width options.
The Zebra selection and border changes in the same source message are already represented; acceptance of separate color-reference documentation does not further change the Zebra design state.
